reinstallHelp: Reinstall the current kernel: local slots replace the mounted kernel / cli-node and restart processes; cluster slots rebuild the image with the same kernel, cli-node and Go telemetry, then replace containers. Credentials and fingerprints are retained.
updateHelp: Updating all slots reloads running runtimes and collects fingerprints without replacing binaries. KVM slots fail and are skipped if their adapter is not wired.
kernelScope: Both local and cluster slots use the current kernel, cli-node and Go telemetry. Codex slots are excluded.
preserveHelp: Keep credentials, fingerprints and statistics. Replace services and restart running slots.
newFingerprintHelp: Local slots clear the home directory and generate a new machine identity; cluster slots only replace the image.
